Gold 和 Platinum 會員閱讀 HuffPost 零廣告干擾。版面更乾淨、捲動更流暢，更聚焦於重要故事。即日加入。

Celebrities dressed to the nines on Sunday in their boldest and most outlandish looks for the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards red carpet.

While the most recent Emmys red carpet was full of more classic looks — and less fashion risk — the VMAs were the complete opposite. Stars weren't afraid to show off leopard print, a pink button-up with "Madonna" written across it and a pair of red Adidas sneakers on the carpet.

Advertisement

Snoop Dogg hosted the evening at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. This was the first time the award show was held on the West Coast in nine years, and Snoop wasn't going to let that go unnoticed.

Chanel West Coast, Bob the Drag Queen and Chloe Bailey attend the MTV Video Music Awards on Sept. 27.

JC Olivera via Getty Images / LISA O'CONNOR via Getty Images

After it was revealed he would host, Snoop Dogg said in a statement: "MTV and the VMAs have been a part of my story from the very beginning. Some of the most important moments in my career have happened on that stage and at MTV — they gave hip-hop a place to be loud, unapologetic and seen by the world. So to come back and host the VMAs after all these years is a full-circle moment for me."

Advertisement

Fans are hoping to see Taylor Swift appear on the red carpet — this would be her first public appearance since marrying husband Travis Kelce in July. The "New Romantics" singer is up for nine nominations, second only to Madonna with 11.
